comment: Line-coverage floors per module (tools/coverage/coverage_ratchet.py). CI fails when a module is more than allowed_drop percentage points under its floor. Floors only go up: raise one in the commit that raises the module. Measured on CI's Windows job, run 41366283592 (main 2026-11-02): Core 85.3, Presentation 81.9, App 42.9, UI 67.3. The floors are these CI numbers (a local run measured UI at 66.9).
